name: Katayama Ryousuke
source:
Likes: Video games (especially dating sims)
Dislikes: Cold winters and hot summers
Hobbies: Making game walkthroughs, watching anime and collecting rare goods

[url=/c6508]Kizami's[/url] schoolmate who is also [url=/c46700]Ookawa's[/url] best friend, and they always go to school together. Ryousuke's usual routine is to stop at a game and anime store on his way back from school. Lately, he’s been obsessed with dating simulation games.

Gets along well with both [url=/c46700]Kurosaki[/url] and [url=/c11270]Fukuroi[/url], and will often be talking about games with Tomohiro in the student council room while Fukuroi is silently working. Since he's been hanging around, [url=/c11335]Mitsuki[/url] started ordering him to do student council chores.

[Edited from the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Ryousuke_Katayama]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
